summary: QMMM Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a change in its independent registered public accounting firm. On June 5, 2026, the audit committee accepted EliteCPA P.C.'s resignation and appointed GGF CPA LTD as its new independent auditor. EliteCPA had served since December 2025 but never issued any report or had any disagreements with the company. The filing is a routine auditor change disclosure required by SEC rules for foreign private issuers, not a special situation. No deal terms, activist activity, or strategic transaction is involved.
